Dear Dr. Raman,

I am writing to ask that you place a review of the sepsis order set's antibiotic timing recommendation on the December 9 P&T Committee agenda, with 15 minutes allotted.

Our internal audit reviewed 412 sepsis cases from January through September. The median time to first antibiotic was 74 minutes, against our 60-minute target. Subject: Request for December P&T Agenda Item – Sepsis Order Set Review

Dear Dr. Raman,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to respectfully request that the Pharmacy and Therapeutics Committee consider adding a review of our sepsis order set's antibiotic timing recommendation to the agenda for the upcoming December meeting.

As you may know, timely antibiotic administration is a critical component of effective sepsis care. With this in mind, our team conducted an internal audit of 412 sepsis cases from January to September. The audit found that the median time to first antibiotic was 74 minutes, which exceeds our 60-minute target. This is an important finding that we believe warrants the committee's attention.

One contributing factor may be that the order set currently defaults to a pharmacy-verified piperacillin-tazobactam order, which adds approximately 15 minutes of verification time. Additionally, it is worth noting that the 2021 Surviving Sepsis Campaign guideline recommends administering antibiotics within one hour for patients with septic shock or a high likelihood of sepsis.

Given these considerations, I would like to request 15 minutes on the December 9 agenda to present our findings and discuss potential next steps.

Thank you so much for your time and consideration. Please don't hesitate to reach out if you have any questions or would like to discuss this further. I look forward to hearing from you.

Warm regards,
[Your Name]

Subject: Elevator 2 Closed Nov 24-26

Dear Tenants,

I hope this message finds you well and that your week is off to a great start. I am writing to share some important information regarding upcoming maintenance work at our Harlow Street building, and I wanted to make sure you had plenty of notice so that you can plan accordingly.

As part of our ongoing commitment to keeping the building safe and reliable, Elevator 2 will be out of service from Monday, November 24 through Wednesday, November 26 while Kessler Lift installs a new controller. We understand that any disruption can be inconvenient, and we truly appreciate your patience and understanding as we complete this necessary upgrade.

Please note that Elevators 1 and 3 will remain in operation throughout this period. The freight elevator will also be available, but it will be reserved for deliveries only between 8 and 10am each day.

If you or any of your staff or visitors require accessible access, or if you have a large move planned during this time, please email me by Friday, November 21 so that we can make the appropriate arrangements and ensure everything goes smoothly.

Thank you again for your cooperation and understanding. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions or concerns whatsoever.

Warm regards,
Dana Ortiz
Property Manager
